title: Jonah and the Silence
author: Lior Iversen
blurb: Wendell Ravensworth, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
